result:
Comment authors can now edit their own comments from the comments list. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, so none of this has been checked.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` adds `updateComment`, which sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with `{ body }`. It also adds a Zod schema and a `useUpdateComment` hook that refreshes the comments list after saving.
- **Success message:** the "Comment Updated" notification is shown from inside `useUpdateComment`, not from a component. `src/features/CLAUDE.md` says success notifications belong in the mutation hook in `api/`. The existing comment components (create, delete) still show theirs in the component, so this one differs from them.
- **Edit button and drawer:** `features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx` adds an Edit button that opens a form drawer, pre-filled with the current body.
- **Visibility:** in `comments-list.tsx`, Edit shows only when `comment.author?.id` matches the current user's id. Admins don't get an Edit button on other people's comments, but they still see Delete.
- **Mock API:** I added a `PATCH /comments/:commentId` handler in `src/testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts`. It only updates a comment whose author is the current user.
